neet_phy_u07_t04_1.working: From F = ηA(dv/dx), η = F/(A·dv/dx). This gives [MLT^-2]/([L^2][T^-1]) = [ML^-1T^-1].

neet_phy_u07_t04_2.working: Volume is conserved, so R^3 = 8r^3 and R = 2r. Terminal velocity scales as r^2, so v = 4 × 5 = 20 cm/s.

neet_phy_u07_t04_4.working: Terminal velocity is proportional to r^2, so the larger ball falls faster. A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u07_t04_5.working: At terminal velocity, drag plus buoyancy equals weight, so drag equals weight only if buoyancy is neglected. I is therefore incorrect. v = (2r^2ρg/9η)(σ/ρ - 1) is linear in σ/ρ and zero at σ/ρ = 1, so II is correct.
